name: BYTE PHANTOM
realCapabilities: Windows SYSTEM INTELLIGENCE: read-only local host, CPU, memory, disk, and IPv4 interface inventory
NETWORK RADAR on Windows and Android using each device's own native network APIs
Active discovery of directly connected private IPv4 subnets from /22 through /30, capped at 1,022 host addresses per scan
One ICMP echo request per target host during active sweeps, enriched with ARP/neighbor-table MAC addresses where available
Four-second neighbour refresh and scheduled active rediscovery every 30 seconds
Live event history for newly detected devices, IP changes, reappearance, and nodes no longer visible in recent snapshots
Persistent Network Radar journal stored locally on this app installation: first/last-seen timestamps, device visibility, and network-change events
Network Intelligence Dashboard: interactive SVG map of the local scanner and peers actually observed by Network Radar, with ICMP/neighbor/last-seen status and interface/subnet context

android.nativeBridge: Capacitor 6 local Java plugin, registered in MainActivity
android.scanImplementation: /system/bin/ping with one ICMP echo request per host; /proc/net/arp and ip neigh for MAC/interface enrichment

security: Network discovery is limited to directly connected private IPv4 subnets. No port scanning, credential tests, exploitation, internet-wide scans, privilege escalation, or network/system configuration changes. This is not a guaranteed complete router-client inventory; client isolation, sleeping hosts, filtered ICMP, separate VLANs/subnets, OEM restrictions, and emulator NAT can limit visibility. Network Radar device identifiers and timestamps are retained only in this installation's local app storage for up to 30 days; report contents are copied only when the user explicitly requests it. The Network Intelligence Dashboard visualizes only Network Radar observations; its lines are not physical topology or verified routing paths, and the dashboard adds no network probes.

networkRadarJournal.storage: Versioned localStorage on this device; no remote sync or upload
networkRadarJournal.reportDelivery: Copied to the local clipboard only after an explicit user action

networkIntelligenceDashboard.dataSource: Network Radar's existing on-device scan results and persistent local journal
networkIntelligenceDashboard.graphMeaning: Observed peers associated with the local scanner; connecting lines are visual scan relationships, not verified physical links, router paths, or device-to-device sessions
interactions: Select a plotted device to inspect its observed IP, MAC, interface, neighbor state, and first/last-seen timestamps
networkIntelligenceDashboard.networkScope: Existing directly connected private IPv4 subnet scope only; no additional probes
